####################################################################################################
Purpose of script: This script produces descriptive statistics and various plots (maps, histograms, 
density plots) based on the final data sets (s08). It creates visual summaries of study 
participants, study locations, vaccination dates, immunogenicity measurements, and additional maps 
for selected pathogens.
####################################################################################################

# Load packages, themes, directories, and functions
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("00_pck.R")
library(nasapower)
library(tidygeocoder)
theme_set(theme_classic())
```

# Read in the data (only s08 data)
```{r}
dat_l <- lapply(str_subset(str_subset(list.files(glue("{dirs$modfit}"), full.names = TRUE), "s08.rds"),
                           "datase", negate = TRUE), readRDS)
names(dat_l) <- sub(".*brms_(.*?)_(vl|v1)_s08.*", "\\1", 
                    str_subset(str_subset(list.files(glue("{dirs$modfit}")), "s08.rds"),
                           "datase", negate = TRUE))

# Define selected pathogens for the manuscript figure
pat_sel <- c("rota", "hav", "hbv", "dipht", "tetan", "pertuapt", "ipv1",
             "hib", "menc", "strep04", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "vzv")
```

# Prepare data for the plot 
```{r}
# Combine data for selected pathogens and standardize country names
datsel_l <- bind_rows(dat_l[pat_sel], .id = "pat") %>%
  left_join(pat_tidy_names, by = join_by(pat))
```

# Check countries for each pathogen
```{r}
loc_geo <- datsel_l %>%
  group_by(study, country, lon_med, lat_med, kgc_3, reg_6) %>%
  summarise(tot = n()) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# Extract climate
```{r}
clim_l <- list()
for(stu in unique(loc_geo$study)) {
  clim_l[[stu]] <- pomp::bake(file = glue("{dirs$processed}/05_stu_nasapower/stu_nasapower_{stu}.rds"), dir = "", {
    datstu <- filter(loc_geo, study == stu)
    datnasa <- lapply(1:length(datstu$study), function(x) {
      nasapower::get_power(
        community = "ag",
        lonlat = c(datstu$lon_med[x], datstu$lat_med[x]),
        pars = c("RH2M","T2M","T2MDEW","PS","QV2M","TQV", "PRECTOTCORR", "CLOUD_AMT", "EVPTRNS"),
        dates = c("2013-01-01", "2023-12-31"),
        temporal_api = "daily") %>%
      as.data.frame() %>% 
      mutate(
        study = datstu$study[x],
        tot = datstu$tot[x],
        country = datstu$country[x], 
        lon_med = datstu$lon_med[x], 
        lat_med = datstu$lat_med[x], 
        reg_6 = datstu$reg_6[x], 
        kgc_3 = datstu$kgc_3[x])
    }) %>%
      bind_rows()
    return(datnasa)
  })
}
```




# Extract climate
```{r}
clim_l <- list()
for(i in 1:nrow(loc_geo)){
  clim_l[[i]] <- pomp::bake(file = glue("{dirs$processed}/05_stu_nasa_power/"), dir = "", {
    nasapower::get_power(
    community = "ag",
    lonlat = c(loc_geo$lon_med[i], loc_geo$lat_med[i]),
    pars = c("RH2M","T2M","T2MDEW","PS","QV2M","TQV", "PRECTOTCORR", "CLOUD_AMT", "EVPTRNS"),
    dates = c("2013-01-01", "2023-12-31"),
    temporal_api = "daily") %>%
      as.data.frame() %>% 
      mutate(
        pat = loc_geo$pat[i],
        tot = loc_geo$tot[i],
        country = loc_geo$country[i], 
        kgc_3 = loc_geo$kgc_3[i])
  })
}

clim_df <- do.call(rbind, clim) %>%
  rename_with(tolower) %>%
  rename(lon_med = lon, lat_med = lat)
  
```

```{r}
clim_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = RH2M, x = YYYYMMDD, color = country)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_grid(country~.) + 
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year") + 
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(),
        legend.position = "none") + 
clim_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = T2M, x = YYYYMMDD, color = country)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_grid(country~.) + 
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year") + 
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(),
        legend.position = "none") 
```
